summary: Release 2.6 revision 7 is READY_TO_FREEZE. GLM 5.3 session ses_fc30730b5ffe3z2z3VSzFH2OK3 and Grok 4.6 xhigh session 01a03d0c-d42a-79f0-8d6d-d5393390b455 independently verified that runtime artifactRoot work/release-2-6 is distinct from canonical planArtifactRoot plans/release-2-6, compiler and adoption resolve the same packet set, all revision-6 closures remain intact, and no open Medium or High finding remains.

dimensions.rationale: All six requirements remain mapped to six acceptance criteria, evidence routes, owners and final gates without semantic drift from accepted revision 6.
All 54 implementation write paths are unique. Runtime evidence belongs under lead-owned work/release-2-6 and the tracked plan package remains plan authority only.
The exact runtime/plan root split was checked against compiler, adoption, default artifacts and gitignore behavior; all accepted focused and full validation routes remain present.
The required r7 review and lock are revision/digest bound, status metadata is inert without the report, and generated execution artifacts cannot silently enter the tracked plan package.
Accounting semantics, provenance separation, bounded explicit sources and zero model/host/network authority are unchanged from independently accepted revision 6.
Compiler writes and adoption reads work/release-2-6/workflow/task-packets while lock identity remains plans/release-2-6/plan.lock.json. reviewedPlanHash matches revision 7 exactly.

findings.message: Revision 6 used the tracked plan path for both runtime artifactRoot and canonical planArtifactRoot.
findings.requiredAction: Revision 7 routes runtime packets, task artifacts, state and evidence to lead-owned ignored work/release-2-6 while retaining plan and lock authority under plans/release-2-6.

findings.message: Revision 5 omitted two package-pin install guides from publication ownership.
findings.requiredAction: Revision 7 retains revision-6 ownership of both guides under WS26-03.

findings.message: Current package integrity rejects undeclared top-level files but skips undeclared top-level directories.
findings.requiredAction: Within WS26-01, reject undeclared top-level directories with a stable error and regression test so a future artifactRoot regression cannot hide generated subtrees.

findings.message: The future lock-create implementation must source verdict, independence and findings from the r7 report file rather than manifest metadata.
findings.requiredAction: Verify the report-file authority invariant during WS26-01 implementation audit.

findings.message: The phase bound remains a to-be contract on the Release 2.5 source base.
findings.requiredAction: Define MAX_PHASE_RESOURCE_ENTRIES exactly once as 256 and enforce it in builder and validator with 256/257 tests.
